description: Risk-tiered allowlist + extra PreToolUse guard hooks for the core plugin. Consumed by /onboard. The plugin's hooks.json safety floor (git push, force-delete, reset, restore, clean, amend, stash drop, worktree --force, find -exec) is ALWAYS on regardless of tier; the hooks below are additional guards layered into settings.json.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "\brm +(-[a-zA-Z]*r|-[a-zA-Z]*f|--recursive|--force)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:rm-recursive] Recursive/forced rm is blocked at the cautious tier. Delete specific paths or ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "\bsudo\b" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:sudo] sudo is blocked at the cautious tier. Ask the user to run privileged commands themselves." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "(curl|wget)[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(ba)?sh" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:pipe-to-shell] Piping a download into a shell is blocked at the cautious tier. Download, inspect, then run with approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git rebase" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:rebase] git rebase is blocked at the cautious tier. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "git push.*(--force|--force-with-lease|-f\b)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:force-push] Forced push is blocked at the cautious tier. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "\brm +-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|\brm +-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:balanced:rm-rf] rm -rf is blocked at the balanced tier. Delete specific paths or ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "(curl|wget)[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(ba)?sh" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:balanced:pipe-to-shell] Piping a download into a shell is blocked at the balanced tier. Download, inspect, then run with approval." && exit 2; fi'
